_description: Rise FC standalone schema operator — contract schema defining the required shape of a controller review packet. This is a contract definition only. No controller review has been run. No packets exist.
_nonAuthorizationStatement: This schema does not authorize schema output, production deployment, or any implementation action. The controller cannot mutate Phase 0 and cannot self-approve production.

controllerReviewPacket._description: Shape of a controller review packet. Produced after Claude QA finding review. Required before human approval.

reviewId.description: Unique identifier for this controller review packet.

targetRunId.description: The governed run this review packet covers. Must match the runId of the finding set.

qaRunId.description: The QA review run ID this packet is responding to. Must match qaRunId in the Claude QA finding set.

truthFingerprint.description: The truth fingerprint of the source truth used for this run. Must match the locked homepage fingerprint for homepage runs.

qaFindings.description: Array of Claude QA findings being reviewed in this packet. Each item conforms to findingRecord shape in CLAUDE_QA_FINDING_SCHEMA_V1_0.json.

controllerDecisions.description: Array of controller decisions — one per finding. Each decision records the findingId, disposition, rationale, and any patch action.

findingId.description: The findingId from the QA finding set this decision addresses.

descriptions.ACCEPT: Controller accepts the QA finding and recommendation. Applies as-is.
descriptions.MODIFY: Controller applies a modified version of the recommendation. Rationale required.
descriptions.REJECT: Controller rejects the finding. Rationale required. Operator must verify rejection is not a doctrine violation.
descriptions.DEFER: Controller defers the finding to a later run or PR. Rationale required.
descriptions.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Controller escalates this finding to human review. Blocks progression until human resolves.
descriptions.PATCH_REQUIRED: Finding requires a patch before the output bundle can proceed. Patch description required.

rationale.description: Controller rationale. Required when disposition is REJECT, DEFER, MODIFY, or PATCH_REQUIRED.

patchDescription.description: Description of the patch to apply. Required when disposition is PATCH_REQUIRED.

patchRequired.description: True if any finding has disposition PATCH_REQUIRED. False otherwise. A patch must be applied and the run re-reviewed before progression.

humanReviewRequired.description: True if any finding has disposition HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED or if the controller's finalRecommendation is HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Blocks progression until human resolves.

blockerCount.description: Count of BLOCKER severity findings in the QA finding set.

unresolvedBlockers.description: Count of BLOCKER severity findings not yet resolved (disposition is not ACCEPT or MODIFY). Must be 0 before progression.

descriptions.PROCEED_TO_HUMAN_APPROVAL: All findings resolved. Bundle may proceed to human approval step. Human approval is required before implementation.
descriptions.PATCH_REQUIRED: One or more findings require a patch before the bundle can proceed. Re-review required after patch.
descriptions.REJECT_RUN: Controller rejects the entire run. A new governed run is required from the beginning.
descriptions.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Controller escalates the entire packet to human review before any action.
descriptions.DEFER_TO_LATER_PR: Controller defers all unresolved findings to a later PR. Documents which findings are deferred and why.

controllerSummary.description: Controller plain-language summary of the review packet — what was found, what was decided, and what happens next.

nonAuthorizationStatement.description: Must state: the controller review packet does not authorize schema output, production deployment, or any implementation action. Human approval is required. The controller cannot mutate Phase 0. The controller cannot self-approve production.

controllerDecisionEnum._description: Reference enumeration of all valid controller decisions. See CONTROLLER_DECISION_ENUM_REFERENCE_V1_0.md for full descriptions.

finalRecommendationEnum._description: Reference enumeration of all valid final recommendations for a controller review packet.
